text: A chemical factory near Pune released sulfur dioxide into the atmosphere, causing severe air pollution in nearby residential areas.
Emissions of nitrogen dioxide from a major fertilizer plant in Nashik triggered health warnings across the city.
Smoke from agricultural stubble burning in Punjab led to dangerous levels of PM2.5 in New Delhi.
Heavy diesel exhaust from cargo trucks caused high carbon monoxide pollution along the Mumbai highway.
Untreated industrial effluent containing heavy metals was discharged from a textile mill into the Mula-Mutha river near Pune.
Toxic municipal sewage overflowed into the Godavari river in Nashik, contaminating drinking water supplies.
An oil spill from a chemical processing facility polluted coastal waters near Chennai.
Pesticides and chemical waste leaked from an agricultural warehouse into nearby farmlands in Nagpur.
Illegal dumping of industrial chemical waste created severe soil contamination near an industrial estate in Thane.
Excessive noise pollution from heavy machinery at a metro construction site in Bengaluru disturbed residents.
Loud commercial loudspeakers and night construction activities generated hazardous noise pollution in Hyderabad.
Thick black smoke and particulate matter were released by an unauthorized brick kiln in Solapur.
Continuous discharge of untreated wastewater from a paper mill contaminated local groundwater in Kolhapur.
Open burning of solid municipal waste at a landfill near Ahmedabad caused hazardous smog and high PM10 levels.
Leachate carrying arsenic and heavy metals from an unlined landfill polluted surrounding soil in Jaipur.
An explosion at a petro-chemical refinery released toxic gas clouds and high levels of sulfur dioxide near Vadodara.
Exhaust fumes containing nitrogen dioxide and particulate matter from city buses degraded air quality in Kolkata.
Uncontrolled dust and fine particulate emissions from limestone quarrying affected nearby villages in Satna.
Untreated domestic sewage released into the Yamuna river in Agra led to toxic foam formation.
Industrial acid runoff contaminated topsoil and agricultural land near a zinc smelter in Udaipur.
Nighttime heavy vehicle traffic produced intolerable noise levels exceeding decibel limits in Lucknow.
Carbon monoxide emissions from a captive coal power plant degraded air quality in Korba.
Discharge of toxic mercury compounds into a local creek threatened aquatic ecosystems in Vapi.
Excessive fertilizer runoff washed into a freshwater lake in Bhopal, triggering massive algae blooms.
Severe noise pollution from pile-driving machines at a highway expansion project irritated citizens in Surat.
Illegal dumping of hazardous electronic waste contaminated soil with lead and cadmium in Moradabad.
Flaring of natural gas at an offshore oil refinery released large volumes of methane into the atmosphere near Kochi.
Sludge from a municipal wastewater facility leaked into surrounding farmland in Coimbatore.
Smoke and toxic fumes from illegal plastic waste burning created dense haze in Ghaziabad.
Industrial cooling water discharge elevated river temperatures and reduced oxygen levels in Visakhapatnam.
High concentrations of PM2.5 caused by crop residue burning were recorded across Haryana.
Demolition activity at a commercial complex generated thick clouds of mineral dust in Noida.
Untreated tanning chemicals were discharged into local drainage channels in Kanpur.
Vehicle traffic during peak hours caused significant ambient noise pollution near hospitals in Chandigarh.
Coal dust emissions from open-cast mining operations reduced visibility and air quality in Dhanbad.
Chemical solvents spilled from a transport tank truck, contaminating soil along the highway near Bharuch.
Discharge of raw sewage into coastal waters forced beach closures near Goa.
Excessive noise from industrial generator sets alarmed local residents in Indore.
Methane gas leakage from an aging natural gas pipeline caused environmental alarm in Assam.
Heavy metal contamination including lead was detected in soil samples near an old battery plant in Howrah.
